title: Soft Mixture-of-Recursions: Going Deeper with Recursive Vision Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2607.00774v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Vision Transformers are typically scaled by increasing depth or width, at the cost of more unique parameters. We explore recursion as an alternative scaling axis that increases effective computational depth through parameter reuse. Yet simply increasing recursion depth does not reliably improve performance because representations from different recursion stages are not fully utilized. We propose Soft Mixture-of-Recursions (SoftMoR), which learns token-wise weights to combine representations across recursion steps, and instantiate it as the Soft Recursive Vision Transformer (SR-ViT). Experiments on ImageNet-1K, COCO, and ADE20K show that SR-ViT can benefit from deeper recursion while adding few parameters. On ImageNet-1K, increasing recursion depth from T=1 to T=3 improves top-1 accuracy from 79.83% to 82.45% with only 1.1M additional parameters. translated_title: 软递归混合：借助递归视觉Transformer走向更深层
translated_abstract: 视觉Transformer通常通过增加深度或宽度来进行扩展，但这需要付出更多独立参数的代价。我们探索递归作为一种替代性的扩展维度，通过参数复用来增加有效计算深度。然而，单纯增加递归深度并不能可靠地提升性能，因为来自不同递归阶段的表示没有被充分利用。我们提出了软递归混合（Soft Mixture-of-Recursions，SoftMoR），它通过学习逐token的权重来组合跨递归步骤的表示，并将其实现为软递归视觉Transformer（SR-ViT）。在ImageNet-1K、COCO和ADE20K上的实验表明，SR-ViT能够在仅增加极少参数的情况下从更深的递归中获益。在ImageNet-1K上，将递归深度从T=1增加到T=3，仅需额外110万参数即可将top-1准确率从79.83%提升至82.45%。在相同有效深度下，SR-ViT还优于独立参数化的对照模型（原文此处被截断）。
tldr: 提出软递归混合方法（SoftMoR/SR-ViT），通过学习逐token权重融合不同递归阶段的表示，使视觉Transformer能以极少参数增量从更深递归中显著提升性能。
